museum_hall_shell.name: Museum Hall Shell (the court, worn)
museum_hall_shell.description: A two-story stone arcade with an iron-and-glass skylight, erected as a purely visual shell around an existing grid map — Cour Marly / Met / Natural History Museum typology as a kit: pier, lintel, cornice, balustrade, glass grid, orange trees, benches. Configurable width/depth/height. The grid below keeps physics and truth; the shell brings the museum light. First worn by Museum_Spine_Court.
